who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane E (the entry and the special records) under rebuild-1115
what: Making the start rule generic over `NamesSource` (D124) needed three facts the trait has no method for: crate 0's root attributes (`#![no_core]`/`#![no_std]`), the crates a program links (linked.rs `Linked::of` takes `&Names` only), and which crate is Rust's `std` (`graph().sysroot()`). The lane does not own source.rs, so the code is written against named methods (`root_attrs`, `linked`, `sysroot_std`) that another lane must add before anything compiles; blaze-cli program.rs also changed under the lane (a `today` parameter appeared mid-edit).
cost: about twenty minutes to find and name the three, and to re-read program.rs before editing it
cause: linked.rs and the start rule were written over the solved names; the trait grew question by question for the body path, and the start path never asked
whys: the start rule ran only after a solve; nothing asked it over records until the lazy parent; a write-only lane cannot add a trait method it does not own
class: a rule written over the solved names hides facts the records source must answer, found only when a caller asks it over records
prevention: open: the three methods in source.rs (lane M); then `Linked::of` over a `NamesSource` so the link rule has one generic home
workaround: code written against the named methods, each with an OWED comment
